byang lugs bka' srung bsdus mchod ni/hūm̐:sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen gyi:bka' srung khro mo rag gdong ma:bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:chos nyid mngo

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250byang lugs bka' srung bsdus mchod ni/1$0000300 hūm̐: sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen gyi: bka' srung khro mo rag gdong ma: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar mdzod: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan ma: dur khrod gnas pa'i ma mo gsum: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa srungs: e ka dzā ṭi'i bka' nyan ma: dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan po srungs: lha mo nag mo'i bka' nyan pa: dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje legs: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor rnams srungs: hūm̐: gter mdzod bse sgrom smug po yi: gter gyi srung ma sde bzhi po: shar phyogs dung mdzod dkar po yi: dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis po: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rdzogs chen sgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyi: bar chad khyod kyis srung bar gyis: lho phyogs gser mdzod ser po yi: dam can rdo rje legs pa skyong: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags sgrub chen spyod pa yi: bar chad bdud dpung khyod kyis thul: nub phyogs zangs mdzod dmar po yi: dam can gnyan chen thang lha dkar: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rten 'brel chos bdun 'chang ba yi: bar chad zur phud lnga pas srungs: byang phyogs lcags mdzod nag po yi: dam can stong dpon dgra bla'i rgyal: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bod kyi chos skyong rgyal po dang: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: dgra bgegs bar chad khyod kyis thul: spyan ras gzigs kyi bka' nyan ma: bka' srung dbang gi ma mo bdun: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa spel: gshin rje gshed po'i bka' nyan pa: dam can srog bdag mdung dmar can: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo yi: srog rtsa dmar po chod la shog: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan ma:

'chi med nye dbang 'khor dang bcas: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod: o rgyan pad+ma'i bka' nyan pa: bka' srung gter bdag dam can rnams: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag gi bcol pa'i phrin las rnams: thams cad khyod kyis sgrub par mdzod:
ces brjod cing phrin las bcol lo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
